title: WAITING UPON
THE ROCK
end: The Midday Watch — pause and pray at noon
stock_queries: golden midday sunlight streaming through a window onto a wooden desk
soft focus dust motes dancing in a sunbeam during daytime
calm ripples on a quiet pond under high noon sun
abstract close up of textured linen fabric in natural light
steady sunlight over an open field at high noon
shadow of a leaf moving slowly across a wall at midday

scenes.a: That decision pulling at your focus today is exactly where you must find your center.
My soul, wait thou only upon God; for my expectation is from him.
He only is my rock and my salvation: he is my defence; I shall not be moved.
In God is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.
Trust in him at all times; ye people, pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us.
Lord, lead me into this quiet confidence as I return to my work this afternoon.
